sources.title: Qwen3.5 0.8B by Qwen | Model Library | Modal
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 0.8B is a 24-layer causal language model with a vision encoder, trained with early text-vision fusion so it handles text and images natively. Its hybrid layout repeats six blocks of three Gated DeltaNet linear-attention layers followed by one gated full-attention layer, for high-throughput, low-latency inference across its native 262,144-token context.
